title: festuca rubra subvar. alvarensis
intro: Festuca rubra subvar. alvarensis, commonly known as red fescue, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The health benefits of Festuca rubra subvar. alvarensis include soothing digestive issues, lowering blood pressure, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
